caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, patterned water, mountains patterned as dense forest, a pool with a swimming figure among fish and a small boat, a mounted prince with attendants watching from the bank, blossoming trees, a cypress and patterned rocks around, malachite green, cinnabar red, azurite blue, gold, jade white
notes_zh: 《Khusraw 发现 Shirin 沐浴》(Brooklyn Museum, Commons PD)：池中泳者、鱼与小舟，岸上马队与纹样岩。
